Welcome to Rayl
Fast Lightning payments, ready when you are.
Get started
Blink
Connect your Blink account with an API key.
Nostr Wallet Connect
Connect a compatible wallet using its NWC connection link.
Spark
Import your Spark wallet with its recovery phrase.

Small amounts are paid right away. Above your limit, Rayl asks first.
A balance for spending
Top up what you plan to spend, like a prepaid card. Your savings stay where they are.
